runs.summary: Apple’s reported operating growth, margins, and cash generation support a strong recent business picture, while tariff-refund effects and lower capital spending qualify the durability of that performance. Foldable-phone launch reports point to substantial interest alongside supply constraints, but do not establish realized sales. Premium peer-screening context, cautious attributed earnings commentary, and an estimated earnings date leave the near-term market outlook uncertain.

keyFindings.text: For the nine months ended 2026-06-27, SEC-reported revenue grew 16.2% (9-month period ending 2026-06-27), while gross profit and operating income each grew 21.7% (9-month period ending 2026-06-27) and 21.7% (9-month period ending 2026-06-27), respectively. These interim comparisons do not establish a full-year trajectory.

For the same nine-month period, SEC-reported operating cash flow grew 43.1% (9-month period ending 2026-06-27); the free-cash-flow proxy was $110.2B (9-month period ending 2026-06-27). Capital expenditure declined, contributing to the proxy’s increase.

Apple’s June-quarter earnings release reported diluted EPS of $2.02, up 29% year over year, and said tariff refunds contributed $0.11 to EPS and about two percentage points to gross margin. This was quarterly diluted EPS, distinct from the SEC’s nine-month diluted EPS of $6.88 and Yahoo’s trailing EPS of $8.72 with undisclosed accounting scope and period basis; the SEC TTM approximation is also $8.72 through 2026-06-27. The stated provider and SEC trailing values do not differ at two decimals.

The June-quarter release cited double-digit growth across iPhone, Mac, Services, and all geographic segments, but the supplied excerpt does not give segment figures. Nine-month gross margin and operating margin were 49.1% (9-month period ending 2026-06-27) and 33.6% (9-month period ending 2026-06-27), respectively.

Reports describe iPhone Duo preorder interest, purchase limits, and delayed delivery estimates. Apple has not disclosed launch-unit counts in the supplied evidence, so the reports do not establish realized sales or distinguish strong demand from constrained supply.

risks.text: Apple’s filings identify reliance on single or limited component sources and exposure to shortages, supply constraints, component pricing, tariffs, and global economic conditions; the supplied filings do not quantify their current financial impact.

Reported preorder interest and purchase limits coincide with reports of constrained initial availability. Without launch inventory, sell-through, or product-margin evidence, demand and supply effects remain difficult to separate.
A provider-estimated earnings date and attributed analyst commentary leave the timing and expectations for the next reported results uncertain; the commentary is not company guidance.
The peer screen uses a limited peer set and enterprise-value inputs from different dates, so it is a screening comparison rather than a complete valuation conclusion.

catalysts.text: The provider-estimated earnings calendar lists November 2, 2026 after market close. It remains an estimated date, not a confirmed event date.

Reports say iPhone Duo retail availability is scheduled to begin October 23 and describe limited launch availability and delayed preorder delivery estimates. Subsequent company disclosures could provide evidence about realized demand and supply.
Apple’s rebuilt Siri began rolling out in English beta in October, with more languages planned for the following month; the supplied evidence does not quantify adoption or monetization.

Product announcements and an estimated earnings date create near-term event uncertainty; the available evidence does not establish how these events will affect results.

keyFindings.text: For the nine months ended 2026-06-27, SEC-reported revenue grew 16.2% (9-month period ending 2026-06-27), while gross profit and operating income each grew 21.7% (9-month period ending 2026-06-27) and 21.7% (9-month period ending 2026-06-27). These interim comparisons do not establish a full-year trajectory.

For the same nine-month period, SEC-reported operating cash flow grew 43.1% (9-month period ending 2026-06-27). Capital expenditure declined, contributing to the increase in the free-cash-flow proxy; the supplied catalog has no available capex growth metric.

SEC diluted EPS for the nine months ended 2026-06-27 was $6.88, up 22.4% (9-month period ending 2026-06-27) year over year. Yahoo provider trailing EPS is $8.72 with accounting scope and period basis undisclosed; SEC diluted EPS TTM is $8.72 through 2026-06-27, an approximation that adds per-share periods without reweighting diluted shares. The stated values do not differ at two decimals.

Apple’s June-quarter earnings release said tariff refunds added about two percentage points to gross margin and $0.11 to diluted EPS, so those reported benefits may not recur. Nine-month gross margin was 49.1% (9-month period ending 2026-06-27) and operating margin was 33.6% (9-month period ending 2026-06-27).

AAPL’s EV to annualized revenue is 10.29x versus a four-usable-peer median of 8.50x. The comparison mixes October 20 market capitalization with June 27 balance-sheet inputs; it provides a screening comparison, not a complete valuation conclusion.

risks.text: Apple’s filings identify dependence on single or limited component sources, industry shortages, component pricing, tariffs, and global economic conditions as risks. The supplied filings do not quantify their current financial impact.

The latest balance sheet reports a current ratio of 1.00x (as of 2026-06-27) and net debt of $42.8B (as of 2026-06-27). These figures provide liquidity and leverage context but do not alone establish future financing capacity.

catalysts.text: Apple’s October 28 product event is reported to feature a touch-screen MacBook Pro and other devices. The supplied coverage does not quantify expected revenue, margins, or customer demand. [news-equity-1]

Reports say the first foldable iPhone is scheduled to reach retail availability on October 23, with preorder delivery estimates extending into 2027. Launch disclosures could add evidence on realized demand and supply, which remain unresolved in current coverage. [news-equity-5]
